thresholds.source: project design rule anti-alias >=10x ODR; actual BOM R25/R26/C16
HX711 10 Hz ODR behavioural pole + external RC; HX711 chip 50 Hz notch not modelled

notes: External RC corner with the real BOM values (R25/R26=1k, C16=100n, bridge Thevenin 1k) is ~530 Hz, NOT the 1.65 kHz quoted by electronics/simulation/README.md (old netlist omitted the 1k+1k input filters). 50 Hz rejection is dominated by the 10 Hz ODR pole (-14.1 dB); the external RC contributes only -0.17 dB. The HX711 on-chip 50/60 Hz digital rejection is not modelled.
